nas_mount_check.name: Enable NAS Storage Protection
nas_mount_check.description: Turn this on if you are saving music to a Network Attached Storage (NAS) share. It automatically halts the script if the NAS goes offline, preventing your Home Assistant local storage from filling up to 100%.

nas_status_entity.name: Home Assistant NAS Status Entity
nas_status_entity.description: Enter the entity ID of a Home Assistant helper switch, ping sensor, or binary sensor tracking your NAS status (e.g., 'input_boolean.nas_online'). If this entity is off, false, or disconnected, the ripper will pause. This sensors on, true or connected status means the drive is online and ready to be written to.

min_file_size_mb.name: Minimum File Size Threshold (MB)
min_file_size_mb.description: Sets the minimum file size limit in megabytes. Files smaller than this value (such as short ads, station jingles, or interrupted streams) will be automatically filtered out and deleted.

continuous_recording.name: Continuous Recording Mode
continuous_recording.description: Enable this to keep the stream ripper running infinitely in the background. It will automatically restart the recording capture loop if the radio stream disconnects or drops.

musicbrainz_tagging.name: Automatic Tagging
musicbrainz_tagging.description: Tag tracks with metadata from MusicBrainz. Any MP3 saved in your Jake's Station Ripper Tool directory will be automatically sent for tagging.

purge_duplicates.name: Purge Duplicates
purge_duplicates.description: Automatically purge duplicate tracks. Example: Artist - Song(1).mp3

logging.name: Verbose Logging (Optional)
logging.description: Enable streamripper logging, very spammy! 1 stream recommended

streams.name: Music Streams
streams.description: Music Stream URLs. Setup in UI

output_dir.name: Output Directory
output_dir.description: Create directory to save to. NAS/Ext drive recommended
